plants.name: Tulipa gesneriana
plants.description: Cup-shaped blooms stand upright on smooth stems above blue-green leaves. They cover the flat Dutch bulb fields in bands of colour that look like a ruled rainbow from above. Late April is the peak for the fields and the famous flower gardens around Lisse.
plants.bloomingSeason: Early April to early May in the Netherlands, with peak colour around the third week of April
plants.location: Bulb region of the Netherlands, near Lisse and Keukenhof
plants.funFact: In the 1630s, tulip bulbs became so prized in the Netherlands that single bulbs reportedly sold for more than the price of a canal house. The episode is remembered as 'tulip mania'.

plants.name: Wisteria floribunda
plants.description: Long, fragrant chains of pea-like flowers hang from twisting woody vines trained over trellises and temple pergolas. They sway like waterfalls of lilac. In Japan, wisteria viewing is a seasonal ritual. Kyoto's Byodo-in Temple is one of the best-known places to see it.
plants.bloomingSeason: Mid-April to early May in central Japan
plants.location: Kyoto and other parts of Honshu, Japan
plants.funFact: Japanese wisteria twines clockwise as it climbs. Mature vines can be strong enough to crush the supports they grow on, and some specimens live for hundreds of years.

plants.name: Nerine angustifolia
plants.description: This slender South African bulb sends up bare stalks topped with airy clusters of pink, ribbon-petalled flowers. It grows in large colonies on grassy flats and in the mountains. In autumn it brings colour just as the summer rains end.
plants.bloomingSeason: December to the end of April, which covers late April in the Southern Hemisphere autumn
plants.location: Summer-rainfall grasslands of KwaZulu-Natal and neighbouring areas of South Africa, Lesotho and Eswatini
plants.funFact: Nerines belong to the amaryllis family. Their petals have a faint sparkle, which gave rise to the nickname 'Guernsey lily' for related species.
